study: post-hardware supplementary simulation; not preregistered before hardware
conditions: ideal exact probabilities and independently sampled shots
snapshot gate-depolarization plus asymmetric readout, thermal_relaxation=False
noise_limitations: Saved properties lack qubit frequency; use gate-error-only depolarization and readout. No separately modelled T1/T2, idle relaxation, crosstalk, leakage, coherent errors or drift. Gate error may already reflect relaxation contributions. Not a reconstruction of actual noise.
streams: SeedSequence.spawn(80), alternating ideal and noisy per sorted job; seeds fixed before sampling
cost: 2000 simulated shots not equal cost to SA evaluations or QPU shots
reference: exact uniform encoded bitstrings, independently replayed legal plans; known optimum used only for scoring
simulator: Aer statevector trajectories, two threads, one parallel shot, max_memory_mb=2048
analysis: per pairing exact ideal/uniform; hardware and simulated counts, job rates, conditional Wilson CI; no quantum advantage claims
stop_rule: all planned 40 jobs in each condition, no outcome-based stopping
